lua: CAM = require('lib.camera'); W = require('lib.world'); IN_VAN = function(x, z, tx, tz) local h = math.atan(tx - x, tz - z); local v = nova.named('van'); v:teleport(x, z, h); local s = nova.scene_now(); s.mode = 'van'; v.driven = true; v.engine_on = true; nova.named('postmaster').seated = true; CAM.pinned = nil; CAM.reset(h) end; ON_FOOT = function(x, z, tx, tz) local h = math.atan(tx - x, tz - z); local s = nova.scene_now(); s.mode = 'foot'; local v = nova.named('van'); v.driven = false; v.engine_on = false; v:teleport(300, 300, 0); local p = nova.named('postmaster'); p.seated = false; p.x, p.z, p.face = x, z, h; CAM.pinned = nil; CAM.reset(h) end; DRIVE = function(k) local d = W.drives[k]; local pts = d.points; local y = d.yard; local ax, az = pts[1][1], pts[1][2]; local dx, dz = ax - y.x, az - y.z; local l = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz); local back = math.max(0, 22 - l); local r, _, _, _, tx, tz = W.nearest('road', ax, az); local sx, sz = dx / l, dz / l; if r and r.id ~= 'post_road' then local e = r.points[#r.points]; local p = r.points[math.max(1, #r.points - 4)]; local ex, ez = p[1] - e[1], p[2] - e[2]; local el = math.sqrt(ex * ex + ez * ez); sx, sz = ex / el, ez / el else return ax - 0.7, az - 20, y.x, y.z end; return ax + sx * back, az + sz * back, y.x, y.z end
